Snake has one food and no moving objects. Freeway has cars but no explicit goal cells. Breakout has bricks but different action semantics. The low obstacle weights and the need to push movable objects onto reward targets fit Sokoban perfectly. The previous-frame channel is also consistent with tracking box movements.

Game: Sokoban (specifically the Boxoban environment).

Description: The agent moves on an 8Ã8 grid and pushes boxes onto goal squares. Reward is given when boxes are placed on goals; the agent cannot pull boxes, and walls block movement.
